name: Codecov API
tagline: Code coverage reporting and analytics API for CI/CD pipelines
description: Codecov API provides programmatic access to code coverage data, reports, and repository analytics for teams integrating coverage into CI/CD workflows. It supports retrieving coverage metrics, commit reports, and pull request comparisons across major version control platforms.

auth.details: API token via Authorization: token YOUR_API_KEY header; self-serve signup on Codecov

use_cases: get coverage percentage for a repository
fetch coverage report for a commit
compare coverage between pull request and base
